Fix `packages/element/src/textStyles.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 security fixes (two Medium findings). (1) SVG paint injection: sanitizeStyleColor and sanitizeStyleHighlight (lines ~34-63) keep any non-empty string, so untrusted values such as url(#x) or url(https://example.com/a) reach <tspan fill>/<rect fill> in SVG export. Keep a value only when ALL hold: typeof value === 'string'; trimmed.length <= 64; colorToHex(trimmed) !== null; !isTransparent(trimmed). Import colorToHex and isTransparent from "@excalidraw/common" (both exported from packages/common/src/colors.ts:380 and :389; @excalidraw/common re-exports ./colors). Keep returning the trimmed original string (not the hex) and keep sanitizeStyleColor's existing rule that a colour equal to baseStrokeColor is cleared. (2) CPU DoS: add `export const MAX_TEXT_RANGES = 2000;` and in normalizeTextRanges process at most MAX_TEXT_RANGES input entries (ignore entries beyond it, before any per-entry work); keep buildNormalizedRanges' boundary loop as is (the cap bounds it to <= 4000 boundaries x 2000 entries) -- do NOT rewrite it as a sweep. In getUniformTextRangeStyle clamp maxEnd to the queried end `e` (Math.min(r.end, e)) so a huge r.end cannot inflate work. Also re-export MAX_TEXT_RANGES wherever textStyles' other exports are re-exported only if packages/element/src/index.ts uses `export *` from ./textStyles (it is allowlisted, but do not edit it unless needed).

Last failure output: (a) 'while editing a sticky-note label, opening the highlight picker does not open the background picker': AssertionError: expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 3 -- the trigger query matched nothing; (b) 'shifts and extends styled ranges...': expected undefined to deeply equal [{start: 6, end: 11, color: '#e03131'}] -- the range was never applied because the selection/action was not driven correctly; (c) another attempt got [{start:14,end:20}] vs expected [{start:10,end:20}] -- wrong hand-computed expectation. Add ONE new `describe("text range styles", ...)` block inserted immediately BEFORE the final `});` line of the file (line 3597), plus imports added as NEW lines next to the existing ones (never modify line 50 `import { actionBindText } from "../actions";` -- add `import { actionChangeStrokeColor, actionChangeTextHighlight } from "../actions/actionProperties";` as a separate new line after it). Use ONLY these existing patterns from this file/repo: beforeEach `await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />); API.setElements([]);` (as in describe('history') line ~3556); create text: `UI.clickTool("text"); mouse.clickAt(400, 400); const editor = await getTextEditor(); updateTextEditor(editor, "Bid request timeout 120ms");` (updateTextEditor = fireEvent.change + fireEvent.input, from ../tests/queries/dom); select with `editor.setSelectionRange(20, 25)` or `editor.selectionStart = 20; editor.selectionEnd = 25;`; apply colour with `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeStrokeColor, "ui", { color: "#e03131" }); })` and highlight with `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeTextHighlight, "ui", { color: "#ffec99" }); })` (stickyNotes.test.tsx:289 uses this executeAction(action, "ui", value) form); read `h.elements.find(el => el.type === "text") as ExcalidrawTextElement`; commit with `Keyboard.exitTextEditor(editor)`; undo/redo with `Keyboard.undo()` / `Keyboard.redo()`; font size with `fireEvent.keyDown(editor, { key: KEYS.CHEVRON_RIGHT, ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true })` (line ~957); rectangle label: `const rect = UI.createElement("rectangle", { x: 10, y: 20, width: 200, height: 75 }); Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.ENTER); const editor = await getTextEditor();` (line ~2163) then the bound text is the element with containerId === rect.id; re-enter edit: `mouse.doubleClickOn(textElement)` or select it and `Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.ENTER)`, then `await getTextEditor()`; preview layer: `document.querySelector(".excalidraw-wysiwyg-preview")` and its `span` children's textContent and style.color / style.backgroundColor. Colour-picker triggers: the trigger renders `aria-label={label}` and `data-openpopup={type}` (ColorPicker.tsx:315,322); labels are t('labels.stroke')='Stroke', t('labels.background')='Background', t('labels.highlight')='Highlight'; existing tests open them with `togglePopover("Stroke")` / `togglePopover("Background")` from ../tests/test-utils (it installs a ResizeObserver stub and clicks the [aria-label] trigger) -- use `togglePopover("Highlight")` and `document.querySelector('[aria-label="Background"]')`; do NOT guess class names. Sticky note: build it as stickyNotes.test.tsx's createNote does (API.createElement type 'stickynote' with a bound text label, API.setElements([note, label])), then `mouse.doubleClickAt(note.x + note.width / 2, note.y + note.height / 2); await getTextEditor();`.
